title: Wren and the Contact
author: Rosalind Underhill
blurb: Quentin Eriksen, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
